books.title: Gone Girl
books.author: Gillian Flynn
books.description: On the morning of their fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne's wife Amy disappears. Under pressure from the police and media, secrets about their marriage begin to unravel.

books.title: The Pillars of the Earth
books.author: Ken Follett
books.description: Set in twelfth-century England, this sweeping tale follows the building of a cathedral and the lives it shapes across generations of war, passion, and treachery.

books.title: Normal People
books.author: Sally Rooney
books.description: Connell and Marianne grow up in the same small town in Ireland but belong to different worlds. A story about the unexpected ways people affect one another's lives.

books.title: The Martian
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: An astronaut becomes stranded alone on Mars and must use his ingenuity and scientific knowledge to survive while NASA works on a rescue mission.

books.title: Eleanor Oliphant is Completely Fine
books.author: Gail Honeyman
books.description: Eleanor Oliphant leads a structured life with very little to trouble her. That is, until she meets Raymond and everything changes.

books.title: Into the Wild
books.author: Jon Krakauer
books.description: The true story of Christopher McCandless, who gave away his savings and hitchhiked to Alaska to live alone in the wilderness.

books.title: The Name of the Wind
books.author: Patrick Rothfuss
books.description: The tale of Kvothe, a legendary figure in his own time, told in his own words from his youth through his rise from street urchin to master arcanist.

books.title: Station Eleven
books.author: Emily St. John Mandel
books.description: A post-pandemic world where a travelling Shakespeare company moves through the remnants of civilisation, intertwined with the story of the world before the collapse.

books.title: Sapiens
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.description: A brief history of humankind from the Stone Age to the twenty-first century, exploring how biology and history have defined us.

books.title: The Notebook
books.author: Nicholas Sparks
books.description: An elderly man reads to a woman with dementia from a notebook containing the story of two young lovers separated by the differences in their worlds.

books.title: The Way of Kings
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.description: A world of storms, soldiers, and scholars, where a war is being fought across the shattered landscape of the Shattered Plains and ancient powers begin to stir.

books.title: Big Little Lies
books.author: Liane Moriarty
books.description: Three women, three marriages, three secrets. A darkly comic tale of school politics, petty rivalries, and a murder at a trivia night.
